kind-bug-hint: A bug, a crash, something not working as it should
kind-feedback-hint: Rate a mod or tell its author what you think
kind-works-hint: Tell a mod's author it runs fine for you
patched-by: Other mods change how UserFeedback works: {0}. Use Show report to check what would be sent.
too-many-involved: At most {0} other mods can be marked as involved.
describe-bug: What happened, and what did you expect?
attach-screenshot: Attach a screenshot of what you saw
no-screenshot: No screenshot, it could not be taken
include-details: Include game details and logs about these mods
summary-feedback: The report holds your rating and text, plus: {0}.
summary-feedback-only: The report holds only your rating and text.
summary-bug: The report holds your description, plus: {0}. Your name, home folder, server address and IPs are removed from logs.
summary-bug-only: The report holds only your description.
summary-files: files the mods asked for: {0} of {1}
public-allowed: The author may use it on the mod's public page
saved: Feedback saved, type .uf folder to see it.
save-failed: Could not save the feedback, see client-main.log.
save-partly-failed: Feedback saved, but part of it could not be written, see client-main.log.
consent: This uploads your report (your text and what the summary lists) to {0}, a site chosen by the mod's author. Neither UserFeedback nor Vintage Story runs it, and like any site it will see your IP address. Send it there? You'll only be asked once for this site.
consent-relay: Your report (your text and what the summary lists) goes to the UserFeedback relay ({0}), which passes it on to the mod's author. The relay sees your IP address but never gives it to the author. Send it there? You'll only be asked once.
sent-github: Check the GitHub issue that opened in your browser and press Submit. Drag in files from the report folder if you like.
sent-webpage: Report copied, paste it into the page that opened on {0}.
http-sent-follow: Sent to {0}, thanks! Follow it for the author's replies (private link, also in follow-url.txt).
http-rate-limited: {0} got too many reports, try again later.
http-rate-limited-wait: {0} got too many reports, try again in {1} min.
http-not-accepted: {0} doesn't accept reports for this mod (error {1}).
http-too-large: The report is too large for {0}, try without the full logs.
http-unreachable: Couldn't reach {0}, check your internet connection.
kept-in: It's saved, type .uf folder to see it.
send-failed: Couldn't send the report, see client-main.log. It's saved, type .uf folder to see it.
review-title: Files the mods ask to include
review-intro: These files would be included in the report. Switch off any you don't want to send, or open one to see what's in it.
review-intro-send: Before sending: these files would be included. Switch off any you don't want to send, or open one to see what's in it.
left-out: Too big to send whole, left out: {0}
works-ready: Tells the author of {0} that it works for you. Sends only the mod's name, its version and the game's version, through the UserFeedback relay. Once per version.
works-counted: Counted for this version. Thanks! A new version of {0} or of the game can be counted again.
works-checking: Checking whether the author of {0} counts "works for me"…
works-not-counted: The author of {0} doesn't count "works for me" yet.
works-cant-count: {0}'s version can't be counted, its version text is one the relay doesn't take.
works-relay-off: The UserFeedback relay is switched off (RelayUrl in ModConfig/userfeedback.json), and "works for me" only goes through it.
works-thanks: Counted, thanks! The author of {0} will see that it works for you.
works-no-answer: The relay didn't answer, try again later.
works-rate-limited: The relay got too many results from you, try again later.
works-rate-limited-wait: The relay got too many results from you, try again in {0} min.
works-optin: Tell the author when this mod loads with or without errors
works-optin-hint: Checks the game's log a few minutes after you join a world. Sends only the mod's name, versions and whether it had errors.
consent-works-auto: From now on, a few minutes after you join a world, UserFeedback checks the game's log and tells the UserFeedback relay ({0}) whether this mod loaded with or without errors: its name, its version, the game's version and the result, nothing from the log itself. The relay sees your IP address, only for its rate limits, and never gives it to the author. Reports you send through the relay later go there too. Switch it on? You'll only be asked once.
consent-works: This tells the UserFeedback relay ({0}) that the mod works for you: its name, its version and the game's version, nothing else. The relay sees your IP address, only for its rate limits, and never gives it to the author. Reports you send through the relay later go there too. Send it? You'll only be asked once.
